faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Agartala Assistant Professor Grade II (On Contract) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 10 September 2026. It is advised to complete the application process well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced for Assistant Professor Grade II (On Contract) posts?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced for the Assistant Professor Grade II (On Contract) positions at IIIT Agartala.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. (Awarded) in Computer Science & Engineering, IT, or other allied areas with first class in all preceding degrees.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is INR 2000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for SC/ST category candidates is INR 1000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor Grade II (On Contract) post?
faq.answer: The salary is offered as per Level 10 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with an AGP of 6000.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official website of IIIT Agartala or the direct link provided in the important links section.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection process stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Presentation, and Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Assistant Professor Grade II (On Contract) position?
faq.answer: The job type is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIIT Agartala located?
faq.answer: IIIT Agartala is located in Agartala, Tripura, with the pincode 799046.
